finalModelAnchors.scope: Calle Elena north, from the arched gateway onto the north pool lawn to the Cervantes junction. Traced from the 14 October roof photos and the ground photos of 11 October against the registry fronts and the aerial. Positions are approximate (about 0.5-1 m); heights are estimated from the photos, not measured.

lane.trust: Square terracotta lane about 1.4-1.5 m wide between walls and beds (roof photos).

review.trust: Generated garden walls, gates and scattered planting are suppressed here; only the traced features below are built.

gateway.name: Elena north · arched gateway to the north pool lawn
gateway.trust: Arched white gateway at the lane's end, crazy paving and the north pool lawn beyond (IMG_2363, looking down from the roof). Opening width and wall height estimated from door and tile sizes. Audit 2026-10-18: IMG_2202 shows the separate private 36/34 entry west of the covered walkway, not this lawn-end feature; its citation is removed. Position/dimensions unchanged and remain estimates. Owner correction 26 October: east wing now ends on unchanged registry house corner; lane patio junction uses the same line. This is source-supported topology with estimated plan anchors, not measured placement.

walls.name: Elena north · patio wall, east side
walls.trust: Full-height lane-facing privacy wall and timber door in IMG_2363, with a raised shaped door head. Height 1.85 m / door 1.8 m estimated from relative door proportions (about 0.2–0.3 m uncertainty), not measured. Gateway junction snapped to the existing return. The short former 0.95 m gap to the window return is closed as estimated frontage continuity: foliage hides the exact connection; it is not source-registered.

walls.name: Elena north · garden wall and closed timber door
walls.trust: White garden wall behind the planted beds, closed timber door at the east end of their intervening path (IMG_2199-2201). Alignment follows existing bed backs; dimensions estimated, not surveyed. Ends at the photographed door surround; no continuation into the patios is claimed.

walls.name: Elena north · barred window wall at the north end of the bed
walls.trust: Short transverse white wall with a barred dark window faces south along Elena (IMG_2200/2201). Approximate placement against the existing magnolia bed; no unseen enclosure is inferred.

walls.name: Elena north · visible front-patio divider to house
walls.trust: One cross-patio divider is visible above the table and blue tarp in IMG_2363, joining the lane-facing wall to the house frontage. The bounded model fragment is fitted to the unchanged wall and registry face (about 0.5–1 m plan uncertainty); height estimated to match the privacy wall. No repeated concealed partitions are inferred.

beds.name: Elena north · planting strip, west side
beds.trust: Planting along the west houses between their wall and the lane (IMG_2363). Width from the registry front; kerb height estimated. Ends at the covered walkway. Audit 2026-10-18: IMG_2202 shows the separate private 36/34 entry west of the covered walkway, not this lawn-end feature; its citation is removed. Position/dimensions unchanged and remain estimates.

beds.name: Elena north · magnolia bed
beds.trust: Raised bed of tall glossy magnolia-like shrubs edged with strap-leaved plants, beside the lane (IMG_2365 from the roof). Extent from the aerial canopy; approximate.

beds.name: Elena north · hedged bed with pollarded tree
beds.trust: Bed boxed by a clipped hedge with a pollarded tree (IMG_2199-2201 at ground level, IMG_2365 from above). Approximate.

beds.name: Elena north · second hedged bed

planters.name: Elena north · white planter box

planters.name: Elena north · white planter box

gardenPath.name: Elena north · paved approach between the hedged beds
gardenPath.trust: Terracotta spur visible between the two hedge-edged beds in IMG_2200/2201. Uses the existing bed edges; the path stays open up to the photographed closed door.

frontPatioFloor.name: Elena north · bounded visible first-patio plain square tiles
frontPatioFloor.trust: Only the first patio floor visible in IMG_2363, bounded by gateway return, lane wall, one visible divider and house. Plain square tiles align with local frontage; phase is independent of the public lane. Extents are fitted to estimated model walls/unchanged registry, and surveyed-ground draping is a model assumption, not a measured private floor level. Hidden garden-patio floors remain unmodelled.
